sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully preserves the conditional per-machinery-installation hazard/evidence rule, uses the canonical ship-to-installation and installation-to-associated-equipment paths, covers all supplied controlled hazards without conjunctively requiring them, and does not make installations or associated equipment mandatory.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the six unconditional sh:hasValue constraints on hasApplicableHazard: they incorrectly declare every listed hazard applicable and turn the ice-accretion/snow-accumulation “and/or” wording into a conjunction. Encode conditional, per-machinery-installation coverage: evaluate only asserted hasApplicableHazard values from the supplied controlled list and require hasHazardProtectionEvidence when such applicable-hazard coverage is asserted; do not require evidence or any hazard value where no listed hazard is applicable. Preserve the ship-to-installation path and the installation ownership of hasApplicableHazard, hasAssociatedEquipment, and hasHazardProtectionEvidence; do not make machinery installations or associated equipment mandatory solely from this universal rule.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: hasAssociatedEquipment
Semantic validator feedback: Preserve the existing conditional per-installation hazard/evidence logic and ship-to-installation path, but add the COMPLETE dependency-contract relationship nltl:hasAssociatedEquipment. Coverage must apply to both each machinery installation and each associated-equipment item linked from it, without making either installations or associated equipment mandatory solely under this universal rule. Do not relocate installation-owned properties to the ship or introduce a convenience coverage boolean.

Candidate faithfully preserves the conditional per-machinery-installation hazard/evidence rule, uses the canonical ship-to-installation and installation-to-associated-equipment paths, covers all supplied controlled hazards without conjunctively requiring them, and does not make installations or associated equipment mandatory.
